definitions.explanation: A count of one hundred people.

examples.japanese: {百人|ひゃくにん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
⟦{参加者|さんかしゃ}→参加者：03059_sankasha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{百人|ひゃくにん}⟦ぐらい→ぐらい：02900_gurai⟧だった。
examples.english: The number of participants was about one hundred.

examples.japanese: {百人|ひゃくにん}⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}した→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧。
examples.english: More than one hundred employees attended this meeting.

notes:
{百人|ひゃくにん} is a compound of ⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧ (one hundred) and the person counter ⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧. It is used as a round number for people in everyday contexts.

COUNTING NOTES:
⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧ combines regularly with ⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧. For multiples, note sound changes:
- {二百人|にひゃくにん}: 200 people
- {三百人|さんびゃくにん}: 300 people (びゃく)
- {六百人|ろっぴゃくにん}: 600 people (ぴゃく)
- {八百人|はっぴゃくにん}: 800 people (ぴゃく)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{百人一首|ひゃくにんいっしゅ}→百人一首：22329_hyakuninisshu⟧: a famous anthology of 100 poems by 100 poets, also a traditional card game played at New Year
- {百人|ひゃくにん}⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧: more than 100 people

USAGE:
Often used as a benchmark number: {百人|ひゃくにん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧ (one in a hundred).
